text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"Controlled paragraph structure with clear topic sentences","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in a more orderly progression, with each body paragraph developing one main point."},{"evidence":"Repeated use of transitions like \"One way,\" \"Another way,\" and \"A final way\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay uses signposting and linking phrases to connect claims and guide the reader through its argument."},{"evidence":"Longer, more developed explanation of each point","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay more fully explains its reasons instead of relying mainly on brief assertions and anecdotes."},{"evidence":"Relevant examples such as \"which college they should apply to\" and \"what sport they may want to tryout for\"","quality":"support","description":"The essay backs its claims with examples that are tied to the point being made."},{"evidence":"Mostly understandable sentence structures with few disruptive errors","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows better control of grammar and syntax, so the meaning is easier to follow."},{"evidence":"Academic argument phrases like \"multiple opinions,\" \"biased opinions,\" and \"prepared\"","quality":"academic diction","description":"The essay uses more formal vocabulary suited to an explanatory essay."}]}
